g.text: PCB: C4 100n at U2 pins 1 (VDD) + 7 (VDDO), tight loop

g.desc: PCB: C4 100n at U2 pins 1 (VDD) + 7 (VDDO), tight loop

g.text: to pin 8 (GND); GND via at cap pad. C5 100n at X1 pin 4 (VDD).

g.desc: to pin 8 (GND); GND via at cap pad. C5 100n at X1 pin 4 (VDD).

g.text: Jumpers: JP102/JP103, JP122/JP123, JP142/JP143 in-line, normally closed (cut to remove filter).

g.desc: Jumpers: JP102/JP103, JP122/JP123, JP142/JP143 in-line, normally closed (cut to remove filter).

g.text: JP104/JP124/JP144 filter bypass, normally open (bridge after cutting in-line pair).

g.desc: JP104/JP124/JP144 filter bypass, normally open (bridge after cutting in-line pair).

g.text: Keep in-line jumper pads <=2 mm from junction (PLAN 6).

g.desc: Keep in-line jumper pads <=2 mm from junction (PLAN 6).

g.text: Filter values are interchangeable per output (same footprint):

g.desc: Filter values are interchangeable per output (same footprint):

g.text: CLK0/CLK1: 60 MHz Cauer (HF + 6 m; matched pair keeps quadrature phase).

g.desc: CLK0/CLK1: 60 MHz Cauer (HF + 6 m; matched pair keeps quadrature phase).

g.text: CLK2: 160 MHz Cauer. Not a harmonic filter for HF bands.

g.desc: CLK2: 160 MHz Cauer. Not a harmonic filter for HF bands.

g.text: Si5351A + 25 MHz TCXO copied from Si5351A Breakout Rev F (R5/C5/C6/R6/C4, XB open). Each output: Rs 0R -> Cb 100n DC block -> DNP shunt -> 7th-order Cauer LPF between NC solder jumpers, NO bypass jumper -> SMA.

g.desc: Si5351A + 25 MHz TCXO copied from Si5351A Breakout Rev F (R5/C5/C6/R6/C4, XB open). Each output: Rs 0R -> Cb 100n DC block -> DNP shunt -> 7th-order Cauer LPF between NC solder jumpers, NO bypass jumper -> SMA.
